verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official Agent SDK (referenced in docs and a dedicated GitHub repo for building agents into TypeScript applications) plus an App Server that exposes agents to client applications through this SDK, giving AI-native developers a first-party programmatic interface. Missing for 10: evidence of multiple language SDKs beyond TypeScript, a public OpenAPI/reference spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json), and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building against the SDK.
